assert_is_instance_check_type: assert an object is an instance of a given class and raise TypeError if not
none_throws_validate_not_none: throw a ValueError if a value is None, optionally with a custom message
test_assert_is_instance: test the assert_is_instance function to verify it raises TypeError for mismatched types
test_none_throws: test the none_throws function to verify it raises ValueError when given None
summarize_typing_utils: summarize the typing utility functions assert_is_instance and none_throws
